			function readTrafficClass(win) {
  const allowed = [
    'none',
    'datacenter',
    'vpn',
    'tor',
    'public_proxy',
    'web_proxy',
    'residential_proxy',
    'search_engine',
    'unknown',
  ];
  const botScreens = ['800x600', '1280x1280', '1600x2000', '1800x1125'];

  let label = null;
  let bot = false;
  try {
    const navigation = win.performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0];
    const entries = (navigation && navigation.serverTiming) || [];
    for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
      if (entries[i].name === 'traffic') {
        label = entries[i].description;
      }
      if (entries[i].name === 'bot') {
        bot = true;
      }
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
  } catch (e) {
    label = null;
  }

  if (!allowed.includes(label)) {
    return null;
  }
  if (label === 'search_engine') {
    return label;
  }

  if (label === 'datacenter' && !bot) {
    try {
      bot = botScreens.includes(win.screen.width + 'x' + win.screen.height);
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
    } catch (e) {
      bot = false;
    }
  }

  return bot ? label + '_bot' : label;
}

function pushTrafficClass(win) {
  const label = readTrafficClass(win);
  if (!label) {
    return;
  }
  win.dataLayer = win.dataLayer || [];
  win.dataLayer.push({ traffic_class: label });
}
